package main
import (
"io"
"io/fs"
"os"
"os/exec"
"path/filepath"
"runtime"
"golang.org/x/tools/go/packages"
)
// wrappers to facilitate test injection
// rootHandle is the subset of *os.Root methods the SUT calls.
type rootHandle interface {
io.Closer
Name() string
}
type nullRoot struct{}
if runtime.GOOS == "windows" { return "nul" }
return "/dev/null"
}
type pkgLoader func(cfg *packages.Config, patterns ...string) ([]*packages.Package, error)
type runner interface { Run(*exec.Cmd) error }
type realRunner struct{}
// writeFS defines an interface that extends fs.FS with writing capabilities.
// This abstraction is necessary to allow for mocking the file system within
// unit tests, as the standard "os" package cannot be directly mocked.
type writeFS interface {
fs.FS
Create (string) (io.WriteCloser, error)
MkdirAll (string, fs.FileMode) error
ReadDir (string) ([]fs.DirEntry, error)
ReadFile (string) ([]byte, error)
WriteFile(string, []byte, fs.FileMode) error
OpenRoot (string) (rootHandle, error)
Open (string) (fs.File, error)
Stat (string) (fs.FileInfo, error)
}
// localFS provides a concrete implementation of the writeFS
// interface by wrapping the standard "os" package. This allows
// the SUT to perform actual system operations while remaining
// easily testable via alternative implementations.
type localFS struct{}
return os.OpenRoot(name)
}
return os.Open(filepath.Clean(name))
}
return os.Create(filepath.Clean(name))
}
return os.MkdirAll(path, perm)
}
return os.ReadDir(name)
}
return os.ReadFile(name) // #nosec G304 - all input is either user-specified or generated herein
}
return os.WriteFile(name, data, perm)
}
return os.Stat(name)
}
